_comment: All bytes are 0x-hex, lower case; uint values are JSON numbers. Generated by clients/clientkeys/scripts/pqchat-vectors.mjs (src/pqchat.js); never edit by hand. Random inputs are fixed: rnd(name, n) = the first n bytes of keccak256("scaas/pqchat/vectors/<name>/0") ‖ keccak256("scaas/pqchat/vectors/<name>/1") ‖ …; the labels are in the generator. Sources: docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-25-ua7-pq-e2e-sessions.md (§4, §6, §7, §10), docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-07-pqchat-public-topics.md (§2), plan block "Group 3c" (3C-D3, 3C-D5, 3C-D9). UNAUDITED. The session records (spec §4). DS_C = keccak256(abi.encode(keccak256(domain.type), keccak256(name), keccak256(version))); typed = keccak256(0x1901 ‖ DS_C ‖ hashStruct); uaMessage.digest = uaMessage(kind, purpose.hash, typed) (ua.js, kind 0x0131 mldsa65). Ids: sessionId = keccak256(abi.encode(tag session, creator, uint64 nonce)) (also epoch 0's epochId); epochId = keccak256(abi.encode(tag epoch, sessionId, author, uint64 nonce)); a leave's and a message's id = typed. Scopes (3C-D5): session keccak256(abi.encode(tag scope/session, creator)); epoch and leave keccak256(abi.encode(tag scope/epoch, sessionId, author or member)); message keccak256(abi.encode(tag scope/message, epochId, sender, bytes16 device)) (messages.json devices), its nonce = counter. The session's members are sorted by ua, carol's via is a non-zero msig seat; its wrapHashes are keys.json wraps "session/*" in member order, its sealedInfo messages.json sealedInfo "session"; the epoch's are "epoch-1/*" and "epoch-1". Signers: ML-DSA-65 keys by pq.js pqKeygen(seed, "mldsa65", account, index), signatures by pq.js signUA (deterministic, extraEntropy false), UASig keyData and members empty. The message row: sigHash = keccak256(abi.encode(UASig)), UASig = (bytes keyData, bytes signature, (uint16, (uint16, bytes)[], bytes)[] members); blob = abi.encode(record as its ABI tuple, sigHash) (3C-D3). The remove row (P48): alice, the admin of epoch 1, removes its members (strictly sorted), nextEpoch = epoch 1's number + 1; members is a bytes32[], keccak256 of the packed words as admins; scope = the epoch scope (sessionId, admin), shared with alice's epoch; no id. The signature-storage setting (CTR-CHAT-23, owner 2026-11-23): sigStore its two modes (PQZ's numbering); every row is signed (uaSig, sigHash), blob is what a none instance keeps and blobSigned = abi.encode(record as its ABI tuple, sigHash, UASig) what an sstore2 instance keeps, the signature view returning that UASig. The epochDevices row (owner (M) 2026-11-23, CTR-CHAT-24): bob's plain rekey of epoch 1 adding his device key (keys.json kemKeys "bob-device", KEM version 4, random per device, not seed-derived): members strictly sorted by (ua, keyId), one wrap per entry (keys.json wraps "epoch-2/*"), the MemberKey type unchanged. The group mode (owner 2026-11-23, CTR-CHAT-25): PqChatSession carries uint8 groupMode as its last field, 0 flat wraps; sessionTreeKem is the session with groupMode 1 (TreeKEM), signed; the mode is accepted from the tree module on (CTR-CHAT-26), 2-255 refused (PqChatModeUnsupported); sessionMode2 is the session with groupMode 2, signed, and its error (PqChatModeUnsupported(2), checked before the lists, the signature and the nonce). The path-less delta (docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-25-treekem-pathless-add.md §3.1): PqChatSession ends with uint32 pathRefreshBound and bytes32 confirmTag, both 0 in mode 0; sessionBound0, sessionBound24, sessionBound510 are mode-1 sessions accepted with those bounds; sessionBound511, sessionMode0Bound1 and sessionMode0Tag are refused with their error (PqChatShape).

PqChatSession.type: PqChatSession(bytes32 creator,uint64 nonce,bytes32 homeChain,address homeChatContract,bytes32[] admins,MemberKey[] members,bytes32[] wrapHashes,bytes sealedInfo,uint8 groupMode,uint32 pathRefreshBound,bytes32 confirmTag)MemberKey(bytes32 ua,uint64 keyId,bytes32 via)
